Staff Software Engineer (Thomas)

Thomasnet, part of Xometry, is the industrial platform where millions of buyers find and source from North American manufacturers and suppliers.

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join Thomas engineering. Thomas is moving from a traditional supplier directory to AI-assisted sourcing, and you will set technical direction for the shared systems and AI infrastructure that this shift depends on, while staying hands-on in the code.

How You'll Contribute

• Hands-on technical leadership. Write and review architectural plans for new projects, then participate in implementation with the teams.

• Guide innovation. Champion a good mix of proven and cutting-edge technologies and methods. Know when to change course and when to double down on what already works, including how we adopt AI across the platform.

• Teaching and mentorship. Serve as a mentor and guide to engineers across the organization, helping them grow their skills.

• Code review. Do code review and mentor others across the org to perform good code reviews.

• Operational excellence. Deliver reliable, high-quality software that exceeds customer expectations and aligns with business timelines.

• Collaborative strategy. Build strong partnerships
